name: IMG_LOAD_BALANCE_AUDIT
description: This table holds information about the actions the Radiant Load Balancer took on studies at each instant in time.

columns.name: ORDER_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the order record.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this record. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this record.

columns.name: LD_BALANCE_ACTION_C_NAME
columns.description: The specific action taken on an order by the Load Balancer at a given instant in time.

columns.name: LD_BALANCE_STDY_PRI
columns.description: The priority score of the study at a given instant in time.

columns.name: LD_BALANCE_ACN_INST_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: The instant in time at which a load balancing event took place.

columns.name: LD_BALANCE_ADT_USER_ID
columns.description: The user who initiated a load balancing action such as reassigning a study to another provider, returning a study for redistribution, or signing a study.

columns.name: LD_BALANCE_ADT_USER_ID_NAME
columns.description: The name of the user record. This name may be hidden.
